effect_size.excerpt: However, we did observe an inverse association for serum selenium only among African-American men (p trend = 0.02); men in the third tertile of selenium concentrations had a 41% lower risk (95% CI: 0.38-0.93) of prostate cancer when compared to men in the first tertile. Overall, our study found no association of serum antioxidants or 15-isoprostane F(2t) with the risk of prostate cancer.
